English: This is a lot of money for {cat}.
Could not load the money boxes.
Money left: {balance}. Most you can spend at one time: {limit}
Chichewa: Ndalama zotsala: {balance}. Zochuluka kwambiri nthawi imodzi: {limit}
Shona: Mari yasara: {balance}. Yakawanda yaunogona kushandisa kamwe: {limit}

English: Wait! That is a lot of money
You want to spend {amount}. You only have {balance}. This is more than half of your money. Do you want to go on?
Chichewa: Mukufuna kugwiritsa {amount}. Muli ndi {balance} yokha. Ndi ndalama zoposa theka la zomwe muli nazo. Mukufuna kupitiriza?
Shona: Unoda kushandisa {amount}. Une {balance} chete. Iyi inodarika hafu yemari yaunayo. Unoda kuenderera here?

English: You cannot spend more than half of your money at one time. Write {limit} or less.
Chichewa: Simungathe kugwiritsa ndalama zoposa theka. Lembani {limit} kapena kuchepera.
Shona: Hauzogoni kushandisa mari inodarika hafu. Isa {limit} kana pasi.

English: You spent too much on {name}. You are {over} over. Spend less here.
Chichewa: Mwagwiritsa ndalama zambiri pa {name}. Mwapitirira {over}. Gwiritsani pang'ono pano.
Shona: Washandisa mari yakawanda pa{name}. Wadarika {over}. Shandisa zvishoma pano.

English: You are using {name} money too fast.
You are spending too fast this month.
Shona: Uri kushandisa mari nekukurumidza mwedzi uno.

English: You spent more than you have. Stop buying things that can wait.
Chichewa: Mwagwiritsa ndalama zoposa zomwe muli nazo. Siyani kugula zinthu zomwe zingadikire.
Shona: Washandisa mari inodarika yaunayo. Rega kutenga zvinogona kumirira.

English: You can spend about {perDay} each day.
Could not load your money. Please try again.
Shona: Hatina kukwanisa kutora mari yako. Edza zvakare.

English: No money boxes yet. Make your plan first.
Chichewa: Mulibe mabokosi. Choyamba lembani ndondomeko yanu.
Shona: Hapana mabhokisi. Tanga wanyora hurongwa hwako.

English: Write the money you get each month. Then share it into boxes.
Chichewa: Lembani ndalama zomwe mumalandira mwezi. Kenako zigawireni m'mabokosi.
Shona: Nyora mari yaunowana mwedzi. Wobva wagovera mumabhokisi.

English: Plan saved. Go to My money to see it.
Chichewa: Ndondomeko yasungidwa. Pitani ku Ndalama zanga kuti muone.
Shona: Hurongwa hwachengetedzwa. Enda ku Mari yangu kuti uone.

English: Tick Take out now and that money leaves your balance right away. Good for money you send home.
Chichewa: Sankhani Chotsa tsopano ndipo ndalamazo zichoka pa ndalama zanu nthawi yomweyo. Zabwino pa ndalama zotumiza kunyumba.
Shona: Tinya Bvisa zvino uye mari inobva pamari yako pakarepo. Zvakanaka pamari yekutumira kumba.

English: You spent more than you have.
Chichewa: Mwagwiritsa ndalama zoposa zomwe muli nazo.
